## Example document

This is an example document. Feel free to modify it as you see fit - nothing here is important, so you can try out things without running into the risk of breaking things. In contrast, breaking things is good if it helps you learn and understand!

## Working with quarto

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed). Try it out and see what happens!
